title: Position bookmarks and collision ownership
implementation: PlayerFeatures.inl and TrainerBridge.cpp; native lifetime journal reused unchanged.

claims.Finding: The position setter marks Actor+288 bit0x200000, calls3BFB70, copies the supplied vector toActor+1648, forcesW at1660 to1, calls3CCB90 and clears two movement-vector QWORD pairs for actors with category bit2.
claims.Limitations: The setter itself does not prove player generation, scene ownership, destination collision safety or the complete validity of its callees. It is called only after trainer guards.

claims.Finding: Enable sets Actor+292 mask0x40 and Actor+2248 mask0x1000, then assigns the override pointer at2312 from argument2.
claims.Limitations: The trainer requires a null existing pointer and clear bits before its own null-pointer override.

claims.Finding: Release clears Actor+292 mask0x40 and Actor+2248 mask0x1000 and zeroesActor+2312. The trainer mirrors only the two masked clears after proving that the pointer remains zero and both bits remain set.
claims.Limitations: Matching final values cannot detect another writer that changes these fields and later reproduces the same profile.

contracts: Bookmarks pin the verified Actor generation. Capture rejects an unavailable observer. Return revalidates generation, current actor/status, scheduler and all10room bytes before the native setter. Observed identity/scene loss and Reset discard the bookmark and balance its pin.
Collision leases pin the Actor generation before their first write. The original two bits must be clear and override pointer zero. Disable/reset records release intent.

A release completes only on the same verified current Actor and saved scene. Both bits are cleared only if the entire owned profile remains present; divergent profiles are relinquished without writes. Retired generations drop their bookkeeping without touching a replacement.

Off-current, absent, scene-mismatched or observer-faulted leases remain pinned and pending. A new collision lease cannot replace them. TrainerFrame services pending release even while the host heartbeat remains expired.
Ghost Walk uses only the native Return operation. It no longer falls back to axis writes or a room reload after the guard refuses the saved bookmark.
limits: The one native bookmark is still shared by manual use, Ghost Walk and other position features. A manual capture on the same live Actor can replace its destination; no owner token or operation receipt exists for this older command family.

A fatal bridge failure disables normal frame servicing. Best-effort immediate release can succeed for a verifiable current actor; already unresolved collision state cannot be promised to restore later in that failed bridge.
An observer fault cannot establish destruction or safely restore collision flags; pending state may remain until game restart.
These older scalar commands do not have the movement protocol's retained ACK receipts. A transport timeout can still leave an ambiguous command outcome.
No live gameplay test, game process injection, save write or Twitch API operation was performed.
